title: Folder
description: A synced folder: per-member paths (Syncthing devices and rclone remotes), bisync settings, versioning, watcher settings.

name.description: Stable identifier. Also used as the Syncthing folder ID.

ruleset.description: Ruleset name from rules/. Compiled per-folder into compiled/<name>/.

enabled.description: False parks the folder: no bisync legs are scheduled and apply refuses. Config-level and durable — use pause/resume for a runtime hold on the live Syncthing folders.

paths.description: Per-member paths. Keys MUST match host names from hosts/. For engine: syncthing members the value is an absolute local path; for engine: rclone members it is the path inside the remote (e.g. sync/media-photos).

bisync.description: Defaults for the scheduled rclone bisync legs that connect engine: rclone members in paths to the anchor. Ignored when the folder has no rclone member.

anchor.description: Optional host name override for the bisync anchor. Default: the unique syncthing host with role: cloud-edge. Must appear in paths.

schedule.description: Cron expression for the rclone bisync jobs. Per-member override: overrides.<member>.bisync.schedule.

flags.description: Flags passed to `rclone bisync`. Defaults are recommended; override here.

ignore_perms.description: True for cross-platform folders (Mac/Win/Linux UID and mode bits differ).

conflict.description: Folder-wide conflict resolution policy. Compiler maps policy to engine-specific flags.

overrides.description: Per-member overrides. Syncthing members: fields that may legitimately differ per host (type, ignore_perms, fs_watcher_*, versioning). rclone members: bisync schedule/flags.
